description:
Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref: P0233.21 dated 12/05/2022 to allow for amendments to: 
- Marginal changes to line of external envelope
- Marginal changes to position and size of external windows and doors
- Rooflights omitted
- Internal changes to 5 residential units
- Changes to podium garden layout and landscaping
- Addition of roof ladder
- removal of glazing top of the entrance door and bin/cycle store

(Demolition of 2-storey retail/commercial building and erection of 4-storey mixed use building containing 3 x Class E units and 4 x 1-bed, 8 x 2-bed and 7 x 3-bed Class C3 residential flats.)
decision_conditions: The amendments to the approved application listed below are considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in their own right and will not require resubmission of a fresh planning application.
- Marginal changes to line of external envelope
- Marginal changes to position and size of external windows and doors
- Changes to podium garden layout and landscaping
-- alteration to the entrance door and bin cycle store

The applicant is informed that this amendment relates solely to the item detailed above and shown on drawing number listed in the application form (as ), and  not to any other deviation from the approved drawings.

Furthermore these amendments do not in any way alter the terms of the associated legally binding s.106 legal agreement, the CIL payment, nor remove any previous conditions imposed on the original approved application Ref; P0233.21 dated 12/05/2022.

The applicant is also informed that, not all conditions with respect to the approved scheme have been discharged. The applicant is strongly encouraged to seek to discharge all conditions, in particular any pre commencement condition, or else such conditions might be considered to go to the heart of the permission, and a true 'condition precedent' meaning
